---
title: Round 7 referee calculations
---

The study tests whether expanding the measured CO₂ partial-pressure window improves the salt-anchored MEA fit while retaining its original properties and screening coverage.
Deviations on fitted rows describe calibration. The phase calculations screen finite sets of fluid states on declared feeds and pressure bases.
The notebook identifies numerical misses and their consequences for the proposed declarations. It awaits independent evidence review and investigator promotion for manuscript use.

## Disposition

- E and D5 · MEA model selection — Both expanded 419-row fits improve the hot-pressure bias. Their legacy partial-pressure AARD rises by more than 11 percentage points from the F2 replay, above the 2-point limit. The incumbent has 251 qualifying measured-state searches out of 321 after pressure refinement. F2 has 253 and F4 has 248. Each expanded fit has one incomplete 162-state census entry. No resolved descent was found in these finite screens. The exact #435 MEA declaration remains the historical carbamate donor.
- A · MDEA reference pressure — At 383.15 K and 121.309 MPa the pressure-tracking split is confirmed. The 100 kPa reference split candidate lowers Gibbs energy. Its liquid-root check remains unresolved. The independent pressure-tracking correction is about −15.7% of the EOS volume. The matched Engine enthalpies at the same composition coincide, while the fixed-volume reference chain term is 17.55 kJ per feed.
- B · MDEA measured-state census — The historical below-bubble group has 27 search attempts on 25 observations. Twenty-one attempts overlap the 222 unfinished #435 searches among 1,564. Two diagnostic IDs have no current property row. The four Sobrino liquid-branch predictions exceed observations by 1.36–1.82 kg/m³. At 262.862 MPa the historical comparison confirms a split and the salt case remains unresolved.
- C · MDEA pressure reweighting — Pressure AARD on 66 fitted loaded totals is 10.12% to 4.15% for salt and 20.09% to 4.46% for the historical pair. The original-weight objectives worsen in both pairs. The original and RMS salt screens each confirm one split at different grid states. The historical RMS screen confirms four compared with zero in the original historical grid census. Both RMS screens have more unfinished searches.
- D · Declaration sensitivities — The MEA electrode discrepancy spans −0.150 to +0.138 pH on the digitized 197 points. Cai reweighting slightly reduces its alternate objective and raises the original objective. Removing the MDEA binary bound produces 14 descents, one incomplete native search and a hull-onset bracket of 413.052–413.150 K. The AMP conditional slope profile has crossings near −155.7 and +47.2 K. The six AMP inward variants retain unresolved phase identities at the historical absolute pressure after detecting descents. The six MDEA inward variants leave the matched high-pressure split unresolved.
- DEA and F · Broader measurement coverage — The original DEA transfer replays the #435 objective exactly with the historical donor. The expanded 140-row objective falls from 26.43 to 15.54. The broadened fit has four confirmed measured-state splits, an unresolved fifth descent and one incomplete search. Seo–Hong pressure AARD remains 66.20%, the seven outside-fit Lawson rows have 37.20% AARD, and the Horstmann excess-enthalpy sign misses on all 14 rows. The maximum conditional methane shift is 0.318 MPa for the refit. Dissolved methane effects remain unbounded by the experiment.
- AMP · Inherited carbamate inputs — Both free- and fixed-slope AMP fits converge and preserve the donor checks. Their objectives are 75.11 and 76.35 on 214 rows, versus 76.31 and 77.64 for #435. Each native and supplied-bank search completes all 666 declared states without a resolved descent. The historical absolute-pressure worked state has unresolved phase identity for the free-slope endpoint.
- H · Source and package readbacks — Kuranov Table 2 row 72 is the unmatched 82nd observation. Historical Hartono S11 gives 1.1144% bubble-pressure AARD and 3.8890% vapor mole-fraction AARD. The strict canonical Hong group solves all 132 equal-fugacity rows and fails the local test on 131. Both packages replay all 120 rounded S15 cells, with physical-check misses retained. The study wheel replays all 85 historical S16 and 53 S17 cells at displayed precision. Public 1.3.2 replays 62 historical S16 cells at displayed precision and omits the plane-value error diagnostic. It replays 52 of 53 S17 cells. The revised S16 exercise retains the parent, trial and failed phase attempts at the same pressure. A future #430-qualified wheel is pending.
- Execution — A simultaneous SIGTERM ended the initial C and E searches before their configured limits. Its sender remains unverified. The reruns retained completed work and checkpointed batches. The retained timing and refusal records give each interruption, failed implementation check and recovery.

## Calculation basis

The MEA objective adds 112 CO₂ partial pressures to the original 307 rows at the original pressure weight. The 12 hot Wagner observations enter only the 66-row comparison. The measured-state phase search uses recorded total pressure where available and retains assigned pressures with their basis elsewhere.
The DEA objective combines 90 partial pressures at a log scale of 0.09 and 50 integral heats. The methane calculation uses the calibrated apparatus range and a dry Redlich–Kwong gas. Its liquid calculation holds the methane-free composition fixed.
The MDEA alternative uses an average of squared standardized residuals for each Table S12 family. The loaded-total-pressure group uses a log scale of 0.015. Ermatchkov and Xiao are development comparisons under both weightings.
The reference-pressure readback adds $\sum_i n_i c_i(T,P_{\rm src})$ to the EOS Gibbs energy in the neutral reaction gauge. At fixed $T,n_i$ its pressure derivative contributes $\sum_i n_i (\partial c_i/\partial P_{\rm src})(dP_{\rm src}/dP)$. The caloric readback compares the explicit temperature derivative at frozen reference pressure with the chain term when the reference pressure follows $P(T,V,n)$.
